导演意图（自然语言）：手持中景，轻微晃动。工作台上，一堆不一样的旧机器用线连成一团，旁边是一台崭新的黑色服务器。宋工指着屏幕上两条交叉的曲线对波爷说；波爷盯着屏幕，慢慢推了推眼镜。环境声：风扇声、机器的嗡鸣。
情绪：triumphant, quiet, revelatory
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium shot, handheld with a gentle sway
景深与虚实：Natural depth of field, the monitor glow slightly blooming.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Night in the lab, handheld documentary medium shot: on the workbench a scrappy tangle of mismatched cheap machines (an old radio, a robot-arm controller board, a cash-register board, two dented tin boxes) wired together, next to one sleek black server unit; Song points at a monitor showing two abstract glowing curves that cross each other; Boye stares at the screen. Blocking lock: the tangle of cheap machines sits at frame left on the bench, the sleek black server at frame right; the monitor with the two curves at the back centre; Song stands centre-left pointing at it, Boye at frame right facing the screen.
Picture 2: Boye at 44 (Song's colleague, network protocol engineer, in the 2050s) (character reference; role: Song's colleague). A 44-year-old Chinese man, network protocol engineer: short black hair with the first grey streaks, dark stubble, intact black-framed glasses, a broad nose and a stubborn mouth. Dark navy quilted work jacket over a brown knitted vest.
Picture 3: the 550 project laboratory at night (2050s) (location reference; role: location reference). Interior of the quantum-computer laboratory of a national research institute at night in the 2050s: a long cluttered engineer's workbench with a soldering station, oscilloscopes, coils of wire, circuit boards and notebooks under a desk lamp; behind a large glass wall, a cold clean server hall with rows of tall black cabinets and, on the central black cabinet, a single round red-glowing camera lens exactly like the terminal in the reference image. Fluorescent tubes. Empty of people.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Song (a man in his early thirties, warm and gentle voice with a smile in it) — 宋工（三十出头男性的声音，温和、带笑意）: 两三台不一样的破机器连起来，就能赢过一台最强的。
现场环境声：cooling fans whirring, electrical hum, a faint relay click

[Shot 1] At 0.0s, medium shot, shoulder-mounted handheld documentary camera, riding the operator's shoulder with one very slow gentle sway that drifts from a medium shot of the workbench to a slightly tighter medium shot holding both men and the monitor, reacting half a beat late; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: the tangle of cheap machines and their loose cables at frame left on the bench, the sleek black server at frame right, the monitor with the two crossing curves at back centre, Song at centre-left in profile with his arm coming up, Boye at frame right facing the screen, the bench edge and a coil of wire soft in the near foreground. Start: Song's right hand rises into frame and his forefinger settles on the exact point where the two glowing curves cross on the monitor, his fingertip almost touching the glass. End: Boye lifts his right hand and slowly pushes his black-framed glasses up the bridge of his nose with two fingers, the lenses catching a green-cyan flare, while Song's hand lowers a few centimetres and hangs still; both men stay looking at the screen and the frame holds. Mood: quiet, revelatory, quietly triumphant. Blur: the monitor glow blooms slightly at its edges and the server hall behind the glass wall dissolves into a soft green-cyan haze, while Song's pointing hand, the two crossing curves and Boye's glasses stay sharp.
